This is the tutorial-style report source. It is intentionally kept next to the
R scripts so the project shows both an interactive analysis and a reproducible
document workflow. Rho can display the generated `output/rho_demo_report.html`
in Viewer; render this file with Quarto when Quarto is installed.

```{r}
clean <- readRDS("data/processed/gapminder_clean.rds")
continent_summary <- readRDS("data/processed/continent_summary.rds")
model_results <- readRDS("data/processed/model_results.rds")
head(clean)
continent_summary
model_results
```

## Interpretation

The latest-year scatter plot shows the broad positive association between income
and life expectancy. The model is deliberately simple: its purpose is to make a
model object and a compact result visible in the workspace, not to claim a
causal explanation.

## Provenance

The data source and checksum are recorded in `data/raw/source.json`.
